top_creatures.label: Gilt-horned beetle family
top_creatures.why: horn shape alone tells the variants apart; a queen and eggs give a nest feeling
top_creatures.keep: horn-variant silhouettes; queen plus egg stage
top_creatures.change: gold reads from a rim-light shader on a steel-blue carapace, not a recolour; new horn shapes

top_creatures.label: Reincarnating boss
top_creatures.why: a boss that changes element and splits its court is a fight inside a fight
top_creatures.keep: named forms as separate monsters; escort court
top_creatures.change: forms triggered by health bands; one silhouette and one sound per form

top_creatures.label: Pack-leader triplet
top_creatures.why: one base creature gives three roles, so pack variety costs little art
top_creatures.change: role cues are a banner, a horn or an aura, not names

top_creatures.label: Tidewater reskin family
top_creatures.why: a zone identity from a palette family of twelve
top_creatures.change: each reskin gets one new behaviour, for example surfacing

top_creatures.label: Four-minion court
top_creatures.why: four distinct minions plus a phantom give a readable pack around one boss
top_creatures.change: each minion has its own silhouette, not four palette swaps

top_creatures.label: Elder tier
top_creatures.why: an age mark on a known creature reads as a tier without a new name
top_creatures.keep: the elder tag as a visual tier with extra ornament
top_creatures.change: age marks are our own motif

top_creatures.label: Race and size training dummies
top_creatures.why: the race and size tags are a ready test set
top_creatures.change: labelled targets in our Pit with a readout of the active damage modifier
top_creatures.ref: MonsterNameTable.js lines 2424, 2435, 2436; tags in ItemRandomOptionTable.js file lines 98-117 and 168-173

top_creatures.label: Seasonal reskin set
top_creatures.why: a holiday palette over the same silhouette is a cheap event
top_creatures.keep: silhouette unchanged; palette and one prop
top_creatures.change: our event gives one new silhouette per event

looks.label: Banded aura ring
looks.technique: three bands, each with radius, tilt, sweep and spin; per-element height from a sine profile; spin from elapsed time over 25 ms
looks.ref: src/Renderer/Effects/SwirlingAura.js lines 80-92 and 259-260; src/Renderer/Effects/SwirlingAura.fs; src/DB/Effects/EffectTable.js lines 4295-4299

looks.label: Level-tier sparkle bubble
looks.technique: separate effect id that spawns camera-facing sparkles on the owner

looks.label: Threshold-keyed glow ring
looks.technique: keeps only bright texels (each channel above 0.5) and sets a fixed alpha; hard edge

looks.label: Soft-knee bloom
looks.technique: bright-pass threshold 0.88 with soft knee 0.45 before composite

looks.label: Cartoon edge pass
looks.technique: edge from two colour differences, then a power curve and a power factor

looks.label: MVP minimap cross
looks.technique: boss flag from packet marks the mob; MVP spawn puts a cross on the minimap
